items.title: 修正 B-688d artifact provenance 时间与路径
items.context: 把 generatedAt 调整为不早于声明输入，移除/替换已清理 worktree 的绝对路径，保持 artifact 引用可在 main 工作区追溯。
items.userSees: User sees artifact provenance PASS: generatedAt is after declared inputs and no B-688d artifact points to the deleted .worktrees/B-688d path.

happy.desc: Generated timestamps are not earlier than their declared input artifacts.

edge.desc: All old .worktrees/B-688d absolute paths are replaced with current repo-relative artifact paths.

adversarial.desc: Reject provenance that claims an artifact consumed an input generated in the future or located only in a deleted worktree.

items.title: 修正 baseline failure 语义矛盾
items.context: 保持 outcome=FAIL 和 blockedReason=local independent review evidence is missing，但不能同时说 terminal criteria 未满足且 terminalCriteriaSatisfied=true；同步 JSON/Markdown 报告。
items.userSees: User sees baseline failure reason PASS: failed expected-PASS runs cite missing independent local review evidence, not a contradictory terminal criteria failure.

happy.desc: Expected-PASS failed runs keep outcome=FAIL and blockedReason=local independent review evidence is missing.

edge.desc: No report says terminal criteria were not satisfied while terminalCriteriaSatisfied=true and terminalCriteriaFailures is empty.

adversarial.desc: Reject any wording change that turns missing review evidence into PASS or hides the block.

items.title: 刷新 evidence hash 并复核 authority/host-neutral 不变
items.context: 更新 shared-contract evidenceRefs sha，运行机械一致性检查和多 host reviewer concern 回归；不得改变 GO-NOT-YET、authorityMode=off、evidenceClass=local-lifecycle、2 host/8 lane/4 lock 语义。
items.userSees: User sees authority/host-neutral regression PASS: shared-contract hashes are refreshed and GO-NOT-YET, authorityMode=off, evidenceClass=local-lifecycle, 2 hosts, 8 lanes, and 4 locks are unchanged.

happy.desc: Shared-contract evidenceRefs match the current SHA256 of every referenced artifact.

edge.desc: The fix does not change host-neutral dispatch shape: canonical codex/claude-code hosts, 8 lanes, 4 locks.

adversarial.desc: Reject any fix that changes GO-NOT-YET into GO or upgrades local-lifecycle evidence to receipt-backed authority.
